intro: Lesson 58: Understand and use degrees. To understand that angles are measured in degrees and how turns link to degrees

blocks.text: A quarter turn is 90°; a half turn is 180°; a three-quarter turn is 270°; a full turn is 360°. From N to E clockwise is a quarter turn.

questions.q: Facing N, turn clockwise to W. Degrees?
questions.model: Teacher: N to E 90, to S 180, to W 270.

questions.q: A third of a full turn?
Degrees in: a quarter turn; 3 right angles; a full turn and a half
questions.model: Teacher: a quarter turn is one right angle: 90°.

questions.q: From N, how many degrees clockwise to SE?
A full turn is... A) 360° B) 180° C) 100°
Big question: why is a full turn 360°?
questions.a: That is how degrees are defined: a full turn is split into 360 equal parts
